spec.studio_prompt: A modern outdoor lounge armchair measuring 70 cm wide, 70 cm deep, and 75 cm high, constructed with a slim matte charcoal black metal tubular frame (#353230). The curved top armrests and back rail are tightly bound in light ash grey braided synthetic rope (#bbb6b4), extending into open vertical and criss-cross rope webbing (#9b9797) around the back and sides. A thick, tailored square seat cushion is upholstered in slate grey outdoor canvas (#616168), complemented by a plush, angled rectangular back cushion in heather grey textured weave fabric (#7b797f).
